sources.title: GR00T N1.5 - research.nvidia.com
sources.snippet: Introduction We introduce GR00T N1.5, an upgraded version of the GR00T N1 foundation model for humanoid robots. With several architecture, data and modeling improvements, we find that N1.5 outperforms N1 on both simulated manipulation benchmarks and on the real GR-1 robot, detailed below.
